steps.text: Click "New post" to open the compose dialog.
steps.title: Open the composer

steps.text: At the top of the dialog, switch to the "Poll" tab. Extra fields appear: question, answer options, closing date, and visibility.
steps.title: Switch to a poll

steps.text: Type the poll question in the editor, just like a regular news post.
steps.title: Ask the question

steps.text: Choose whether members can select a single answer ("Single choice") or several ("Multiple choice"). We keep "Single choice".
steps.title: Single or multiple choice

steps.text: Enter the first possible answer.
steps.title: First option

steps.text: Enter the second possible answer.
steps.title: Second option

steps.text: Add as many answers as you need.
steps.title: Add an option

steps.text: Provide at least two answer options. The "Add option" button adds more, and the trash icon removes one.
steps.title: Add the answer options

steps.text: Pick the closing date and time from the calendar. After this deadline no more votes are accepted and, depending on the chosen visibility, results may be revealed.
steps.title: Set a closing date

steps.text: Three presets cover the most common cases. Each one combines what managers see, what members see, and when.
steps.title: Choose who sees the results

steps.text: Members see only the total number of votes per option, and only after they have voted themselves. Nobody sees who voted for what — managers also get totals only. Ideal for a confidential vote.
steps.title: Anonymous

steps.text: Everyone sees the full results immediately, including who voted for which option, even before voting. Ideal for an open decision where everyone owns their choice.
steps.title: Transparent

steps.text: Members only discover the totals once the poll closes; until then results stay hidden. Managers, however, see the breakdown (who voted for what) at any time to follow participation.
steps.title: On close

steps.text: The "Advanced" button reveals three independent settings. A preset is just a shortcut for these three fields — you can combine them freely.
steps.title: Fine-grained control (advanced)

steps.text: What managers see. "Aggregate": only the totals per option. "Full": the per-voter breakdown — who voted for each option.
steps.title: Manager visibility

steps.text: What members are allowed to see. "None": never any results. "Aggregate": the totals. "Full": the per-voter breakdown.
steps.title: Member visibility

steps.text: When members see what they are allowed to. "Never", "Before vote", "After vote", or "When the poll ends". This setting is what distinguishes, for instance, a vote whose result only appears once participation is recorded.
steps.title: Member display

steps.text: To finish, we pick the "Anonymous" preset again, which collapses the advanced settings and applies a consistent, ready-to-publish combination.
steps.title: Back to a preset

steps.text: Click "Publish". The poll is broadcast to every member, who receives a notification inviting them to vote.
steps.title: Publish the poll

steps.text: The poll appears on the board with its options. Members can now vote; results will be shown according to the visibility you chose.
steps.title: Your poll is live
